; ======================

; ===========================

; ===========================

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (ERROR Int)(schedule Ref)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-Event (sel-Event Event))
  (lift-Schedule (sel-Schedule Schedule))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-Schedule ((this Ref)) Schedule

; ----------------------------

  (and (< (Event.t1 this) (Event.t1 other)) (< (Event.t2 other) (Event.t2 this)))
)

  (and (< (Event!t1 this) (Event.t1 other)) (< (Event.t2 other) (Event!t2 this)))
